en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a landscaped park with a circular flowerbed and low wire fence in the foreground, a tree‑lined path and streetlamps, and a tall neo‑Gothic style memorial column or tower (the Schwedendenkmal) in the background. There is also a cylindrical advertising pillar on the left. Red printed German text at the top identifies the location as Freiberg i. S. at the Schwedendenkmal, and an additional red line of text appears at the lower right.
